risks.title: Recession
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions the risk of a recession in the United States or globally, which could have a negative impact on its sales and profitability.

risks.title: Acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: The company highlights risks related to acquisitions, including difficulty integrating acquired companies, potential loss of key personnel, and internal control issues.

risks.title: Tariffs and trade restrictions
risks.score_rationale: The company mentions the impact of tariffs, trade restrictions, and retaliatory measures between the United States and China, including rare earth export restrictions.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in highly competitive markets with competitors having greater brand recognition, larger installed product bases, and greater financial and technological resources.

risks.title: Foreign exchange fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks related to foreign exchange fluctuations as 48% of its sales come from international customers and its operations span multiple countries.

risks.title: Government shutdowns
risks.score_rationale: U.S. government shutdowns could lead to delays in contract awards, issuance of export licenses, and payments to government customers.

ai_positioning.summary: TDY does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K/20-F filing.
